usernames.title: Target Usernames
usernames.description: List of X/Twitter handles to scrape. Accepted formats (mix and match freely): plain handle (elonmusk), with @ prefix (@elonmusk), or full profile URL (https://x.com/elonmusk or https://twitter.com/elonmusk). Add one entry per line in form view, or switch to JSON for bulk paste.

cookies.title: Session Cookies / Cookie Strings
cookies.description: List of raw cookie strings or Playwright storageState cookie objects for X/Twitter authentication.

delayBetweenRequests.title: Delay Between Requests (ms)
delayBetweenRequests.description: Pause between each profile visit in milliseconds to reclaim memory and throttle requests.

batchSize.title: Batch Size
batchSize.description: Number of profiles per batch before upserting/flushing.

executionMode.title: Execution Mode
executionMode.description: Run sequentially using 1 browser or in parallel using multiple cookie sessions.

maxRetries.title: Max Retries
maxRetries.description: Number of retry passes for profiles returning N/A or Error.

supabaseUrl.title: Supabase Project URL
supabaseUrl.description: Optional Supabase Project URL for direct cloud streaming persistence.

supabaseAnonKey.title: Supabase Anon/Public Key
supabaseAnonKey.description: Optional Supabase Anonymous API Key for direct cloud streaming persistence.
